imageAltEn: Braised chicken cutlet in creamy kimchi sauce
ingredients: Boneless chicken thigh=1 piece; Mushrooms=10; Onion=1/2; Minced garlic=1 tbsp; Olive oil=As needed; Kimchi=As needed; Water=As needed; Heavy cream=As needed; Parsley=2 sprigs
steps: Cut a few shallow slits in the chicken thigh so it curls less as it cooks. | Pan-fry the chicken until crisp. Flip it and cook until nearly done. | In the same pan, fry the onion, garlic, and mushrooms in olive oil until fragrant. | Stir in the kimchi and add water. Return the chicken to the pan, cover, and simmer over low heat. | Add the cream. Once the chicken is cooked through, take it out and slice it. Turn up the heat to reduce the sauce. | Add the chopped parsley. Once the sauce is as thick as you like, serve it with the chicken.

ingredients: Pork belly=325 g; Cooking oil=1 tbsp; Scallions=As needed; Garlic=As needed; Preserved mustard greens=1/2 bundle; Soy sauce=5 tbsp; Thick soy sauce=3 tbsp; Rice wine=3 tbsp; Ground white pepper=1/2 tsp; Ground black pepper=A pinch; Umami seasoning=2 tsp; Rock sugar=3 tsp; Large chilies=2; Thinly sliced scallions=As needed
steps: Soak the preserved mustard greens in water for 20 minutes. Rinse them three times and set aside. | Slice the pork belly and fry it over medium heat until golden. | Use the rendered pork fat to fry the scallions and garlic. Add the mustard greens and stir-fry until fragrant. | Add the seasonings and bring to a boil. Reduce to medium-low heat and simmer for 15 minutes. | Put the pork and mustard greens in a bowl and lay the chilies on top.
